source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E and back. Then G and G sharp on string 3, sliding into open B.
old: திறந்த B, ஃப்ரெட் 3-இல் D, திறந்த E, திரும்புங்கள். தந்தி 3-இல் G, G ஷார்ப், திறந்த B-க்குச் சறுக்குங்கள்.
context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rust-belt-shuffle “Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

curriculum_refs.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E and back. Then G and G sharp on string 3, sliding into open B.

reason: The source says G and G sharp on string 3, sliding into open B (string 2). A literal same-string guitar slide cannot end at that open B. This may be figurative melodic motion; Tamil follows the source rather than inventing different fingering.
recommended_action: Parent may clarify sliding into as moving to, or provide intended technique. No source edit made.
